daily.today_energy: Mercury's whispering something real today—your intuition is *sharp*. Trust those gut feelings that pop up randomly. Energy feels grounded but curious, like you're ready to explore something new without overthinking it.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, there's a softness in the air worth leaning into. Single? Someone might actually see you properly today. Either way, vulnerability hits different when you stop performing.
daily.career: Your ideas have teeth today. That thing you've been hesitant to mention? The timing's solid. Lead with authenticity instead of strategy—people respond to real way more than polished right now.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding stuff—think walks, water, or literally touching grass. Mental clarity follows when you're not forcing productivity. Rest is also productivity, bestie.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about shedding what no longer serves you. Mercury's movement brings clarity to situations that felt murky before. Trust your intuition—it's basically your superpower right now, and it's firing on all cylinders.
weekly.love: If you've been holding back vulnerability, the stars are gently nudging you to take that risk. Whether single or coupled up, authentic connection is calling. Let someone see the real you beneath the mysterious exterior.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are peaked this week. That project or idea you've been hesitant about? The universe is basically saying go for it. Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed right now.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional rest and movement. Listen to what feels good instead of forcing routines that drain you. Small rituals like walks or stretching can work wonders for your overall vibe.
